follow-up time: Within the first month of life
cohort: 12,708 live births in Pakistan between November 22, 2017, and April 30, 2018
finding: Neonatal mortality rate was high in Pakistan, and factors like unimproved toilet facilities, distance to health facilities, caesarean delivery, and small birth size were associated with increased risk.
mod_finding: Caesarean section deliveries were associated with a significantly higher risk of neonatal deaths (adjusted hazard ratio: 1.6; 95% confidence interval: 0.6-1.9).
followup_time: Within the first month of life
birth_weight: Small size at birth was associated with increased risk of neonatal mortality.
